_about: Invented, synthetic restraint-classifier labels (no household data, invented names). "dev" = what the semantic head was trained and tuned on (written to the policy text by one author). "held_out" = a blind set written by a separate author who never saw the lexicon or the head; it is never used to tune. See scripts/perf/restraint_eval.py.
